outcome: Wire the release machinery into an observable surface: the running Preview version, the promotion conditions still unmet, and the rollback target, read through the API rather than inferred from the repository tree.
non_goals: Do not promote a capability to stable to make the surface look complete
Do not duplicate the release contract's rules in the API layer
Do not place a digest inside a document that reports that digest

transitions.reason: the M5 dogfood design measured that nine of the twelve declared capabilities cannot be exercised and that five of them have no implementation at all; this task owns escalation E22-3, where internal/release is imported by no package outside itself and its own tests, so no Preview version, no unmet promotion condition and no rollback target is observable through any surface, which makes two declared capabilities unexercisable
wo-v2-066に基づき着手。applicationがreleaseをimportする方向で、稼働Preview version・未充足の昇格条件（tri-state）・rollback先をread-onlyのGETで観測可能にする

the five surface tasks were each designed to widen the same six files (the api handler, the application ports, service and read models, the openapi document, the owner console and both stores), so they cannot run at once: three concurrent writers to one file leave the coordinator resolving a textual conflict by hand, and an evidence key measured on a tree that never becomes a commit is the defect that ev-v2-013-infra-plan already recorded. They are serialised, each branching from the tip the previous one landed on
every task this one depends on is complete, so the block has cleared

実装前の測定で2つの停止条件が同時に成立したためcoordinatorが機構を裁定し直した。E1: application->releaseは実辺なので宣言すべきで、V2-045が着地した今ci/components.jsonのprohibitedの理由は消えた。宣言だけ先に入れるとVerifyNoUnjustifiedEdgesが落ちるので、manifest変更とimportは同一commitでなければならず、許可はtask側に渡す。E2: 単一capability射影は使えない。実測で12の拒否classのうち8つが同一error値に潰れ、空capability setを射影するとnilを返してfalse metになる。CanPromoteがfirst-failureの単一errorを返すこと自体が報告面には不適なので、権威側に構造化した拒否列挙を足す。CanPromoteの挙動は不変とし、invariant_model_test.goの既存列挙testをその番人にする
